script: Before you choose a skill, take an honest look at what you already have. You can start with a basic Android phone, or an iPhone with a camera and internet. A laptop helps a lot, but for some skills it is not essential. Check three things. First, your device. Second, your internet, either mobile data or Wi-Fi that works most days. Third, your time. Forty-five minutes a day, five days a week, is enough to begin. If you can give one and a half to three hours a day, you will move faster. Also check your English. You need to read and write it at a simple level, for emails and client messages. You will improve with practice. Finally, check your space. You need a quiet corner where you can sit for about thirty minutes without interruption. A small table near a window is ideal. It does not need to be a separate room.
